description_en: Triggers auto scaling based on a specified adjustment rule by calling the ScaleWithAdjustment API, eliminating the need to create a scaling rule in advance as required by the ExecuteScalingRule API
description_zh: 区别于ExecuteScalingRule接口，您无需提前创建伸缩规则，直接调用API ScaleWithAdjustment接口快速基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容
name: ScaleWithAdjustment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment method for the scaling activity. Valid values:

QuantityChangeInCapacity: Increases or decreases a specified number of ECS instances.
PercentChangeInCapacity: Increases or decreases a specified percentage of ECS instances.
TotalCapacity: Adjusts the number of ECS instances in the current scaling group to a specified number
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整方式，取值范围：

QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的ECS实例。
PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的ECS实例。
TotalCapacity：将当前伸缩组的ECS实例数量调整到指定数量
parameters.name: adjustment_type

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment value for the scaling activity. In all cases, the number of ECS instances adjusted in a single operation cannot exceed 1,000. Otherwise, the adjustment fails. Valid values vary based on the adjustment method:
QuantityChangeInCapacity: -1,000 to 1,000.
PercentChangeInCapacity: -100 to 10,000.
TotalCapacity: 0 to 2,000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整值。任何情况下，单次调整的ECS实例台数都不能超过1000，否则会导致调整失败。不同调整方式对应的取值范围：
QuantityChangeInCapacity：-1000~1000。
PercentChangeInCapacity：-100~10000。
TotalCapacity：0~2000
parameters.name: adjustment_value

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances to be adjusted in the scaling activity. This parameter takes effect only when `AdjustmentType` is set to `PercentChangeInCapacity`
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动最小调整实例数，仅当`AdjustmentType`为`PercentChangeInCapacity`时生效
parameters.name: min_adjustment_magnitude

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to synchronously execute the scaling activity. This parameter is valid only for scaling groups that have the expected number of instances configured. Valid values:

true: Synchronous process. When the scaling rule is executed, the scale-out or scale-in activity of the scaling group is directly triggered.
false: Asynchronous process. When the expected number of instances in the scaling group is modified, the actual scale-out or scale-in activity of the scaling group is not immediately triggered. The system automatically detects the difference between the expected number of instances and the current number of instances in the scaling group, and then triggers the scale-out or scale-in activity.

For more information about the expected number of instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动同步执行开关，仅对具有期望实例数配置项的伸缩组有效。取值范围：

true：同步流程，即执行伸缩规则时会直接触发伸缩组的扩缩容活动。
false：异步流程，即修改伸缩组内的期望实例数时，不会立刻触发伸缩组的实际扩缩容活动，需等待期望实例数变化后，系统自动检测期望实例数与伸缩组内当前实例数不一致，才会触发扩缩容活动。

关于期望实例数的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html。

默认值：false
parameters.name: sync_activity

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current scaling task supports concurrent execution
parameters.help_zh: 当前扩缩容任务是否支持并发
parameters.name: parallel_task

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container startup command. A maximum of 10 arguments can be specified
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多10个
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The startup commands for the container. A maximum of 20 commands can be specified. Each command can contain up to 256 characters
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个。每个命令最多包含256个字符
fields.name: commands

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs for the container. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and cannot start with a digit
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为1~128个字符。格式要求：`[0-9a-zA-Z]`，以及下划线（_），不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. The value can be 0 to 256 characters in length
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The name of the container. When you need to override container parameters, you must specify the container name. The container parameters can be overridden only when the container name matches the container name in the scaling configuration
fields.help_zh: 容器名称。当需要覆写容器参数时，必须指定容器名称，容器名称与伸缩配置容器名称相匹配时，方可覆写容器参数
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The override parameters for the container list
fields.name: container_overrides

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs at the instance level. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size at the instance level. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例级别内存大小。单位：GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The user data of the ECS instance. The user data must be encoded in Base64. The maximum size of the raw data before encoding is 32 KB
fields.help_zh: ECS 实例的自定义数据，需要以 Base64 方式编码，编码前的原始数据最多为 32 KB
fields.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The override parameters specified for scaling out an Elastic Container Instance (ECI) scaling group
parameters.help_zh: ECI伸缩组扩容指定覆写参数
parameters.name: overrides

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable all lifecycle hooks for the scaling activity. Valid values:

true: Disables all lifecycle hooks.
false: Does not disable lifecycle hooks
fields.help_zh:
伸缩活动禁用所有生命周期挂钩。取值范围：

true：禁用。
false：不禁用
fields.name: disable_lifecycle_hook

fields.help_en: The list of IDs of the lifecycle hooks that are disabled for the scaling activity
fields.help_zh: 伸缩活动禁用的生命周期挂钩ID列表
fields.name: ignored_lifecycle_hook_ids

fields.help_en: The default execution result of the lifecycle hook in this scaling activity. If specified, this value overrides the original default execution result of the hook
fields.help_zh: 本次伸缩活动中生命周期挂钩的默认执行结果。设置后覆盖挂钩原有的默认执行结果
fields.name: lifecycle_hook_result

parameters.help_en: The context information of the lifecycle hook
parameters.help_zh: 生命周期挂钩上下文信息
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_context

parameters.help_en: The metadata of the scaling activity
parameters.name: activity_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

None: Not specified. Normal scaling is performed.
PlanOnly: Does not trigger scaling. Only elastic planning is executed. The planning results, including instance types, zone IDs, billing methods, and the number of instances to be created, are returned in PlanResult.

Default value: None
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式
可选值：

None：未指定，正常扩缩容。
PlanOnly：不触发扩缩容，仅执行弹性规划，在PlanResult中返回规划的结果，包括实例规格、可用区ID、付费类型和创建的实例数量等信息。

默认为None
parameters.name: execution_mode

ActivityType.description_en: The type of the scaling activity. If `ActivityType` is `CapacityChange`, the scaling activity corresponding to the returned `ScalingActivityId` only modifies the expected number of instances in the scaling group and does not immediately execute scale-out or scale-in. Applicable scope: scaling groups with the expected number of instances configured
ActivityType.description_zh:
伸缩活动的类型。

当`ActivityType为CapacityChange`时，表示返回值`ScalingActivityId`对应伸缩活动仅修改伸缩组期望实例数，没有立刻执行扩缩。

适用范围：期望实例数类型伸缩组

PlanResult.description_en: The elastic planning results returned when ExecutionMode is set to PlanOnly
PlanResult.description_zh: 当ExecutionMode为PlanOnly时，返回的弹性规划的结果

ResourceAllocations.description_en: The resource allocation information in the elastic planning results
ResourceAllocations.description_zh: 弹性规划结果中的资源分配信息

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Prepaid: subscription.
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值如下：
Prepaid：包年包月
Postpaid：按量付费

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The preemption policy for the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: regular pay-as-you-go instance.
SpotWithPriceLimit: spot instance with a maximum price limit.
SpotAsPriceGo: spot instance whose price is automatically set by the system based on the current market price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例

ScalingActivityId.description_en: The ID of the scaling activity
